description: An educational electronically steered sector search and prescribed revisit schedule. This is one possible scheduling pattern, not a definition of military radar or a model of operational hardware.

synthesis.schedule: Sixteen cycles. Twelve 0.10 s search dwells cover bearings -55 to +55 degrees in 10 degree steps. After search slots2 and8, a0.18 s revisit points at26+0.5*cycle degrees. After slots5 and11, a0.18 s revisit points at-34+0.7*cycle degrees. The complete schedule is prescribed before detection and is not a tracking or adaptive resource-allocation solution.
synthesis.targetModel: Scene A:E=900+12t,N=1900-4t; Scene B:E=-1000+10t,N=1500+3t. Metres,seconds. Fixed horizontal plane, no elevation or target-height solution.
synthesis.beam: Gaussian power response sigma2.1 degrees, FWHM4.945122 degrees. Gaussian range response sigma36 m. Beam direction evaluated at retained dwell midpoint.
synthesis.noise: Exponential mean0.055 plus floor0.025. Broad stationary clutter peak0.42 at bearing-15 degrees and range900 m, angular sigma14 degrees, range sigma240 m, multiplied by uniform[0.8,1.2] texture.
synthesis.attenuation: Scene A gain4.2 becomes0.005 during cycles6–8. Scene B gain3.7 becomes0.005 during cycles11–12. Prescribed fading, not physical obstruction.
synthesis.transient: Additional gain2.4 component at bearing-5 degrees,range2200 m during cycle4. Detector and tracker see only its retained power.
synthesis.truth: Separate positions at each dwell midpoint. Scenario labels never enter the detector or tracker.

detector.threshold: max(0.6,4*mean(range offsets -10..-3 and3..10)), clipped at range boundaries. No calibrated CFAR probability.
detector.peaks: Power at least retained threshold; strictly greater than previous range bin and at least next range bin. First/last range bins excluded. No comparison across neighboring dwells because their directions and durations differ.
detector.localization: Exact retained range-bin center and scheduled beam direction in the fixed local horizontal plane. No subcell position, range interpolation or invented elevation.
detector.timing: Detection time is dwell midpoint; results become available at that dwell end. Arrays are indexed[dwell,range], with direction and duration supplied only by beam-schedule.csv.

tracker.measurement: Common east/north detections only. Assumed independent sigma70 m errors; no truth label or target velocity input.
tracker.transition: Constant velocity. F=[[1,0,dt,0],[0,1,0,dt],[0,0,1,0],[0,0,0,1]]. Q=sigma_a² G Gᵀ, G=[[dt²/2,0],[0,dt²/2],[dt,0],[0,dt]], sigma_a = 1.5 m/s²; each propagation interval has independent assumed acceleration.
tracker.association: Chronological per-dwell measurement updates; greedy squared Mahalanobis gate9.21034; at most one detection per track per dwell. No identity labels and no bearing/dwell-purpose hints.
tracker.initialization: Position from detection, zero velocity, covariance diag(4900,4900,900,900).
tracker.update: Joseph covariance update; predict and export active states at every dwell end. Confirmed after3 total hits. Coasting means no update during this dwell and is common when the beam looks elsewhere; it is not a missed-target claim. Retire after8 seconds without any detection update, not after a fixed number of beam visits.
tracker.uncertainty: 95% Gaussian horizontal ellipse from declared filter covariance. Fixed origin and horizontal geometry treated as exact; not a calibrated accuracy claim.
tracker.fullCovariance: track-state.csv stores all4x4 entries plus total hits and last detection timestamp.

exclusions: No terrain masking, multipath or atmosphere
No target identity or real-world capability claim
No adaptive scheduling, operational military specifications, weapon guidance, threat classification or IFF
No elevation scan, propagation, antenna array or waveform simulation
